newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - European, Japanese ADRs active.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - European, Japanese ADRs active.

text.p: Japanese and European stocks traded in New York were active, with a sell-off in shares of Royal Dutch Petroleum Co.
Traders said that persistantly low refining margins and a poor chemicals market hurt third quarter results for Royal Dutch/Shell Group. Shares of Royal Dutch were down 3-3/4 on the NYSE.
Shares of PolyGram NV was down 7/8 at 46-3/4 on the NYSE. The official opposition in Canada's Parliament urged the Liberal government to block PolyGram from distributing independent movies in Canada.

Japan's Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd was down 1-5/8 at 161-5/8 on the NYSE as industry analysts said that customers may be frusrated to find few software titles for its new super compact disc system players in stores.
Shares of Italy's Luxottica Group SpA, which on Tuesday reported an increase in third quarter revenues were up two at 62-3/4.
